description: This file defines a Java interface 'TransactionFactory' in the package 'org.apache.ofbiz.entity.transaction'. It declares methods for obtaining transaction management objects like TransactionManager and UserTransaction, retrieving a connection, and shutting down resources. It serves as a central source for JTA (Java Transaction API) objects within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TransactionFactory
classes.description: An interface serving as a factory for transaction-related objects, centralizing access to transaction management and connection handling within the framework.

methods.name: getTransactionManager
methods.description: Returns the TransactionManager instance used for managing transactions

methods.name: getUserTransaction
methods.description: Returns the UserTransaction instance for user-controlled transactions

methods.name: getTxMgrName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the transaction manager

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a SQL connection using the provided helper info, potentially throwing SQLException or GenericEntityException

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down or releases any resources held by the factory
